verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents user-definable event-triggered rules, such as triggers or 'when X happens, do Y' workflows. Apps Script automating Admin console tasks is a low-code developer building block with no documented event triggers. Automatic user provisioning sync is a fixed built-in behavior, not a user-defined rule. Context-Aware Access policies and dynamic groups are adjacent access and membership controls, not event-to-action automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
